design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL EN Pin Destruction Trap — 6.5 V Zener Clamp & 7 V Abs Max
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike low-voltage SOT-23-5 LDOs where tying EN directly to VIN is standard practice, the TPS709 EN pin has an internal 6.5 V Zener clamp and 7.0 V Absolute Maximum rating (p.4, p.13). Tying EN directly to a 12 V or 24 V VIN rail destroys the IC! Leave EN floating to auto-enable via its internal 300 nA pull-up, or add a current-limiting resistor.

design_gotchas.title: High 960 mV–1.4 V Dropout at 150 mA Limits 5 V-to-3.3 V Margin
design_gotchas.detail: The 3.3 V TPS70933 exhibits 960 mV typical / 1400 mV maximum dropout at 150 mA (p.5), requiring VIN >= 4.7 V worst-case at full load. It is poorly suited as a low-headroom 3.7 V Li-ion LDO; use it for >= 5 V–30 V keep-alive and industrial rails.

design_gotchas.title: Severe SOT-23-5 Thermal Derating at 24 V–30 V Input & Strict COUT <= 47 uF / ESR <= 0.2 Ohm
design_gotchas.detail: At RθJA = 212.1°C/W (p.4), dropping 24 V to 3.3 V allows only ~22 mA continuous load at TA = 25°C before reaching TJ = 125°C. Also keep COUT strictly between 1.5 uF effective and 47 uF max with ESR <= 0.2 ohm (p.14); high-ESR tantalum or bulk caps destabilize the loop.

design_gotchas.title: TPS709 vs. TPS709A / TPS709B Have Completely Different SOT-23-5 Pinouts
design_gotchas.detail: Page 3 shows that standard TPS709 uses 1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT, whereas TPS709A and TPS709B rearrange IN, GND, EN, and OUT pins on the exact same DBV package. Verify the exact OPN prefix before sourcing.

typical_use_cases: Always-on 12 V / 24 V industrial PLC, metering, and automotive keep-alive 3.3 V rails (1.3 uA IQ)
Multi-cell (3S–7S) battery pack BMS microcontroller supply rails requiring ultra-low standby drain
Back-powered MCU / RTC rails benefiting from integrated 10 nA reverse-current blocking (VOUT > 1.8 V)
Candidate drop-in HV upgrade for Pin-4-NC SOT-23-5 footprints ONLY when EN is disconnected from VIN > 6.5 V
engineering_summary: The TI TPS70933DBVR is an ultra-low-quiescent-current (1.3 uA typ), 30 V max-input (32 V abs max) 150 mA LDO in SOT-23-5 (DBV) with Pin 4 N/C and built-in reverse-current protection. Although it shares the standard 1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT SOT-23-5 pinout, engineers evaluating it as a candidate drop-in must never tie EN to VIN above 6.5 V (7 V abs max clamp), must respect its 1.4 V max dropout at 150 mA, and must enforce 1.5–47 uF COUT with ESR <= 0.2 ohm before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.3 confirmed standard TPS709 DBV pinout (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT) and pinout divergence from TPS709A/B.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.4 confirmed IN abs max 32 V, EN abs max 7 V (6.5 V Zener clamp), Rec Op VIN 2.7-30 V, and DBV RθJA=212.1°C/W.
Verified 3.3 V dropout (960 mV typ / 1400 mV max @150 mA), 1.3 uA IGND, 0.15 uA shutdown, 0-0.2 ohm ESR window, and reverse-current protection on p.5 & p.13-14.
